description: This Java class 'EntityTagMatchers' provides a representation and utility methods for handling collections of 'EntityTagMatcher' objects. It includes methods for creating instances from comma-separated strings or lists of matchers, and supports typical collection functionalities such as streaming, iteration, and equality checks.

classes.name: EntityTagMatchers
classes.description: An immutable collection of EntityTagMatcher objects with utility methods for creation, iteration, and string representation.

methods.name: fromCommaSeparatedString
methods.description: Creates EntityTagMatchers from a comma-separated string of entity tag matcher representations.

methods.name: fromStrings
methods.description: Creates EntityTagMatchers from an array of strings, each representing an EntityTagMatcher.

methods.name: fromList
methods.description: Creates EntityTagMatchers from a list of EntityTagMatcher objects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of EntityTagMatcher objects contained in this collection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated String representation of all EntityTagMatchers in the collection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the collection contains no EntityTagMatchers.
